verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway provides load balancing across multiple LLM models/providers (docs-17, docs-31) and AI Rate Limiting Advanced plugin (docs-12, docs-43) which supports throttling requests, directly addressing spreading traffic and rate-limit smoothing. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm multi-key rotation per provider or request queuing behavior (vs. hard rejection) under rate limits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API-key rotation/spreading across multiple keys for the same provider, and confirmation of queuing (vs. simple throttling/rejection) semantics.
